::: {.naf-home}

```{=html}
<div class="naf-home-app" id="naf-home">

  <h1 class="naf-home-title">Explorateur NAF</h1>
  <p class="naf-home-tagline">
    Chercher un code ou une activité, parcourir la nomenclature, comparer 2008 et 2025.
  </p>

  <div class="naf-versions" role="radiogroup" aria-label="Version de la nomenclature">
    <button type="button" class="naf-version is-current" role="radio" aria-checked="true"
            data-version="2025">NAF 2025</button>
    <button type="button" class="naf-version" role="radio" aria-checked="false"
            data-version="2008">NAF 2008</button>
  </div>

  <form class="naf-home-search naf-searchbox" id="naf-home-form" role="search" autocomplete="off">
    <label class="naf-visually-hidden" for="naf-home-q">Rechercher un code ou une activité</label>
    <svg class="naf-search-icon" viewBox="0 0 20 20" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
      <circle cx="9" cy="9" r="6"></circle>
      <line x1="13.5" y1="13.5" x2="18" y2="18"></line>
    </svg>
    <input id="naf-home-q" type="search" class="naf-search-input"
           placeholder="30.32Y, aéronautique, logiciel…">
    <button type="button" class="naf-search-clear" id="naf-home-clear"
            aria-label="Effacer la recherche" hidden>&times;</button>
  </form>

  <section class="naf-results" id="naf-home-results" aria-label="Résultats de recherche" hidden></section>

  <div id="naf-home-browse">
    <a class="naf-home-cta" id="naf-home-cta" href="explorer/">
      Parcourir la NAF 2025 <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
    </a>
    <p class="naf-home-counts" id="naf-home-counts" role="status" aria-live="polite"></p>
  </div>

</div>
```

```{=html}
<a class="naf-voyage" href="explorer/visualisation.html">

 └ 30

       └ 30.32
          └ <span class="is-5">30.32Y</span></span>

    <span class="naf-voyage-kicker">Voir la NAF autrement</span>

      <svg class="naf-hand-arrow" viewBox="0 0 34 30" aria-hidden="true" focusable="false">
        <path d="M5 6 C 12 8, 20 14, 26 24" />
        <path d="M18 22 L 27 25 L 26 15" />
      </svg>
    </span>
    <span class="naf-voyage-cta">Commencer le voyage&nbsp;→</span>

</a>
```
